note: The script asks for the hook text, her super, one key-word line and J.D.'s super, so 4 graphics and the end card. The other rows are captions only.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top third: She is 14. Adults listened.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05. Colour 14 in NFTE orange #FF5C39 if you rebuild it in your edit.

mg.title: Her super
mg.cue: Name super 00:09–00:11, small, lower left: "NFTE student, age 14".
mg.use: On at 00:09 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. No name, town or school.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words, top third, as she says them: “your message still matters”.
mg.use: On her words, about 00:40. Top third. Keep captions on.

mg.title: J.D. super
mg.cue: Small super from his first word, lower left: "J.D. LaRock, CEO, NFTE"
mg.use: On at 00:53 on his first word for 2.5 s, lower left above the captions. Type the second line CEO, NFTE under it. You hear him, you do not see him.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: NFTE's white logo from the NFTE brand kit (Mac Studio, state/nfte/brand/logos, 9 Oct 2026), endcards/index.json.
mg.use: Right after his last word at 00:59. Hold it to the end, 1 s fade on the music only.
